research_notes: Follow-up: identify earlier agriculture/trade/banking and student employers; obtain Defence start and secondment/payroll record, Eurasia/Hawker dates and hours, SBS departure/full-time terms, and any post-SBS consultancy. Resolve VMC commission versus RAC endpoints and adjunct terms.

2026-09-29: searched APH/Defence biographies, SBS appointment and later employer profiles, Brookings announcement/publication/proceedings, VMC annual report, contemporary SBS inquiry record, ABC reporting, full-time terms and public professional profiles. Found useful primary dates but no adequate full-time interval evidence.

2026-09-29: Brookings July 2006 author page resolves three month-level spells. Secondary accounts suggesting a year at Brookings conflict with October 2004–May 2005 and are not used. October 2004 DFAT/fellowship boundary remains imprecise, so no simultaneous full-time claim.

2026-09-29: SBS annual-report/departure searches did not establish a precise exit or hours. ABC's November 2015 former-executive description and May 2015 committee appearance bound the departure within 2015. Generic immediately-before-parliament biographies must not silently extend SBS employment to July 2016.

2026-09-29: public LinkedIn result https://au.linkedin.com/in/pkhalil surfaced current activity without usable historical chronology. Full-time queries chiefly returned vacancies in his office, not evidence of his own past hours; those adverts were not used.

Pre-Defence work and possible later independent consultancy remain major gaps. Degrees or a generic lawyer label do not establish a legal-practice spell. Do not infer work continuity, calculate totals from senior titles, or sum overlapping secondments and adjunct appointments.

Follow-up2026-10-02: employer annual-report footnotes resolve SBS departure July2015. Own June2010 alumni contribution corroborates simultaneous Hawker Britton consultancy and Sydney adjunct role. No double counting or full-time inference.

Examined SBS2014–15 and2015–16 reports, appointment releases, university alumni profile, historical consultancy and departure searches. Crikey3 September2015 indexed departure lead pointed toward annual reports; restricted article not bypassed. Primary2014–15 report supplies stronger month evidence.

Next leads: exact SBS cessation/contract and leave, Hawker/Eurasia appointment/FTE records, pre-Defence employer identities and dates, post-July2015 consulting, VMC individual appointment/cessation. Defence commencement cannot be inferred from the alumni degree year.
